criteria.evidence: go.mod: module line, go 1.27.1, cobra v1.10.2 (plus its own indirect deps mousetrap/pflag)

criteria.criterion: version text and --json exact format, key order, runtime go/os/arch
criteria.evidence: version.go versionInfo struct field order and Fprintf format; root_test.go TestVersionJSON/TestVersionText check every field and order

criteria.criterion: main.version and main.commit vars default 0.0.0-dev/unknown, ldflags overridable
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/main.go var block; passed via cli.Build

criteria.evidence: embed.go //go:embed all:plugin; version.go uses vloop.Plugin.ReadFile, no os.ReadFile/os.Open of plugin.json

criteria.evidence: manifests match; file listing shows only the two manifests under plugin/ and .claude-plugin/

criteria.evidence: embed_test.go reads the embedded plugin.json; root_test.go TestVersionJSON asserts each field

criteria.criterion: Global persistent flags -C/--dir, --json, --no-color, -q, -v; NO_COLOR and TTY colour rule
criteria.evidence: root.go NewRoot persistent flags; Globals.Color checks NoColor, NO_COLOR and char device (untested but nothing colours yet)

criteria.criterion: Usage errors exit 2 with one 'vloop: ' stderr line, nothing on stdout; distinct exit 1 path
criteria.evidence: root.go Execute, SilenceUsage/SilenceErrors, oneLine, ProblemError -> 1; TestUsageErrors covers unknown cmd, flag, --json, extra arg
only newVersion is added to the root

criteria.criterion: No product code/test touches .loop/, .claude/ or home
criteria.evidence: grep of the changed files shows no such paths; tests use only in-memory buffers
driver's verify gate exited 0, and it covers these

notes: Minor: TestProblemErrorExitsOne only checks the error type from root.Execute, not that Execute() maps it to exit 1; the exit-1 code path itself is untested. Test import block in root_test.go is oddly grouped, but gofmt accepts it. Neither is a reason to fail.
